onClick: {{ (async () => { try { const organizationName = inpCompanyIdentityName.text?.trim(); const reason = inpCompanyIdentityReason.text?.trim(); if (!organizationName || !reason) { showAlert('Enter an organization name and reason.', 'warning'); return; } const rows = await qUpdateCompanyPartyIdentity.run({ organization_name: organizationName, expected_version: qCompanyPartyIdentity.data?.[0]?.identity_version, reason }); if (!rows?.[0]?.party_id) throw new Error('No organization was returned.'); await Promise.all([qCompanyProfile.run(), qCompanyPartyIdentity.run()]); resetWidget('inpCompanyIdentityName'); resetWidget('inpCompanyIdentityReason'); showAlert('Company identity updated.', 'success'); } catch (e) { showAlert('Identity update failed: ' + (e?.message || e), 'error'); } })() }}
